t: You are looking at St Mark's Church, an Anglican church on Hamilton Terrace in St John's Wood, standing where Abercorn Place meets the terrace. The building was completed by 1847. It was badly damaged by a fire on 26 January 2023, and the cause was never explained. The architect was Thomas Cundy, who followed his father as surveyor of the Grosvenor Estate. He held that post while the contractor Thomas Cubitt built up Belgravia and Pimlico, so this church comes from an architect with a big London practice.
